items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: He'd sound just like them guys. Different things he'd do, he'd sound just like them.

ctx.x: Translate it, okay. Now, who is Claude Bolling?

Claude Bolling was a piano player, a young boy during that time. He could play all different styles... I don't mean he don't play different styles. He played like a lot of different piano players from the States. He'd sound just like Claude Hopkins, some of him, some J.P. Johnson, Count Basie, Teddy Wilson -- sounded like them guys. Different things he'd do, he'd sound just like them.
Now, he's made some recordings recently, I think, that were put out...
